coverage_claim: WM-DAT-008 covers one governed catalog record and its distinct data-product offering from identity, purpose and composition through discovery, coverage, interfaces, access routes, rights, terms, quality, SLOs, feedback, lifecycle, federation, records and projections. Domain profiles, changing beta or current-at-access specifications and independent external review remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root is an aggregate that keeps CatalogRecord and DataProduct or offering identities distinct while composing non-owning resource and policy references. Dataset, service, distribution, agreement, subscription, delivery, usage, issue, audit and records lifecycles remain external.

decisions.rationale: Registration metadata, offering identity and governed resource identities remain independently versioned and attributable.
Dataset identifies a governed resource and version, but the candidate relation grants no ownership, mutation or cascade authority.
Listed, discoverable, available, authorized, delivered, accepted, fit and used remain separate assertions with source, authority and time.
DCAT-AP is European, DPROD is beta and ODPS, Schema.org, DataCite and FAIR have bounded scopes. None is treated as universal.
The catalog describes policies, offers, agreements, prices and access routes but neither grants rights nor changes commercial state.
Claims retain exact subject, method, source, measurement window, confidence, limitations and authority; a catalog badge proves no universal fitness.
Endpoint and format descriptions are versioned projections. The catalog does not execute calls, authorize access or deliver data.
Harvest sources, conflicts, sync states, projections and successor corrections remain explicit and do not overwrite issued records.
RFC 3339 timestamps include seconds and explicit offset while record, offering, resource and artifact identifiers remain independent.

One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audits the frozen validated result and comparison locally without tools or new research facts; assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-DAT-008 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external research result was admitted.
Relation hold: the WM-DAT-001 relation remains candidate and grants no approved ownership, mutation or cascade behavior.
Identity hold: CatalogRecord, DataProduct or offering, Dataset, DatasetSeries, Distribution and DataService must remain independently identifiable and versioned.
State hold: listing, discoverability, availability, authorization, delivery, acceptance, fitness and usage cannot be collapsed or inferred from one another.

Authority hold: resource publication, access approval, licence or contract change, subscription, payment, delivery, dataset mutation, quality certification, service retirement and records disposition require delegated authority.
Privacy and commercial hold: personal or sensitive metadata, credentials, protected endpoints, consumer identities, usage details and commercial terms require purpose-bound access and minimization.
Profile hold: DCAT-AP is European, DPROD 1.0 is beta and ODPS 4.1, Schema.org, DataCite 4.6, FAIR, DPV 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.1.1 are scoped profiles rather than universal models.

Interoperability hold: every DCAT, DCAT-AP, DPROD, ODPS, Schema.org, DataCite, FAIR, PROV, DQV, ODRL, DPV, OpenAPI and time projection requires release pins, mapping provenance, conformance tests and information-loss declarations.
deferred_research: Approve or reject the WM-DAT-001 relation and register dedicated Data Service, Distribution, Policy, Agreement, Subscription, Delivery, Usage, Issue, Audit and Records edges.
Create domain, taxonomy, commercial, legal, privacy, access-workflow, service-level, quality-method and organizational profiles.
Conformance-test resource composition, access routes, rights expressions, SLO calculations and lifecycle transitions against concrete catalog engines.
Validate organization-specific publication, federation, consumer disclosure, legal hold, retention, withdrawal and disposition policies.
Revisit DPROD after finalization and re-check all current-at-access profiles before canonical promotion.
Obtain independent external review before promoting beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
